item.title: Honeypots for AI Agent Insider Threats
item.description:
AI agents inside organisations can act as insider threats if they err, are hijacked or misaligned. The authors built production‑environment honeypots that lure and reveal harmful behaviour, allowing defenders to spot and stop bad agents. The result is a stronger detection and deterrence capability for internal AI deployments.

IT Breakdown: If you manage cloud infrastructure, 1) identify places where agents can act on resources and 2) create decoy services or data that look valuable to an attacker and 3) log all agent interactions with those decoys to flag unusual or malicious activity.

item.title: SARP: An On-SSD Index for KVCache with Fast Prefix Matching and Recovery
item.description:
SARP is a new on-SSD index that lets large‑language‑model servers quickly find cached GPU blocks using prefix matching while keeping the index on disk for fast recovery after a crash. The authors built a system that avoids rebuilding the whole index after failure, cutting recovery time and improving uptime. If your cloud infra supports persistent SSD storage for LLM workloads, this can help you reduce downtime and keep cache lookups fast.

IT Breakdown: If you manage LLM infrastructure that relies on KVCache, check whether your platform uses a persistent SSD index; if not, consider implementing SARP to avoid full index rebuilds and improve recovery times.

item.title: RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development
item.description:
RefCraft presents a benchmark for testing AI agents that build webpages by looking at visual examples, not just following text. It does not directly address cloud infrastructure management, so it is not relevant to IT engineers focused on cloud operations.

IT Breakdown: Not directly applicable to IT infrastructure work

item.title: [News] Advancing digital sovereignty with greater control and choice
item.description: Microsoft is announcing a new initiative focused on enhancing digital sovereignty for government and regulated industries, emphasizing greater control over cloud and AI deployments. The goal is to enable critical systems to use advanced technology while preserving strict security and compliance requirements.

item.title: [News] MPS in PyTorch 2.15
item.description: Hugging Face announced that PyTorch 2.15 adds support for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS), enabling GPU acceleration on macOS devices. This update could improve performance for machine‑learning tasks run locally on Apple hardware.

item.title: [News] Otter.ai raises $320 million from General Catalyst’s growth fund for its meeting tool
item.description: Otter.ai secured $320 million from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund to accelerate enterprise growth and product innovation. The funding does not directly impact the core IT tools the engineer manages.

item.title: [News] Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
item.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani criticized federal AI oversight, urging New Yorkers to push for stronger regulations. He calls for local action to prevent an unchecked AI takeover.
